SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS all_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_shop_reading,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_channel_reading,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 AND channel <> 'online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shop_not_channel,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'online' AND store_key <> 999999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS channel_not_shop,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_shop_reading,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'online' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_channel_reading,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gross_shop_reading,
  MIN(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 THEN order_date END) AS first_order,
  MAX(CASE WHEN store_key = 999999 THEN order_date END) AS last_order
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
